name: Tourist / Visitor Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Passport valid for at least 6 months from arrival date.

Visa on arrival is granted at Queen Alia International Airport and the Aqaba border crossing for eligible nationalities (including the USA, UK, Canada, and EU states); the King Hussein/Allenby Bridge crossing does not issue visas on arrival, and other nationalities must arrange a visa in advance.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm nationality-specific visa-on-arrival eligibility or arrange a visa in advance of travel.

evidence_required.document: Visa fee payment (or Jordan Pass covering the fee for 3+ consecutive nights' stay)

outcome.duration_length: short stay; extendable by registering at a local police station before the initial visa expires

sources.title: Jordan Public Security Directorate (PSD), Borders and Residence Department -- Information Services: temporary residency at entry is 2 weeks for unrestricted nationalities (extendable to 3 months after police address registration), 3 months for restricted nationalities
Jordan Pass (private tourism operator) -- entry requirements blog: visa-on-arrival eligible nationalities and border crossings, Jordan Pass fee waiver for 3+ night stays

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- WEAKEST FILE.
